woolwich.region: Woolwich and the Royal Borough of Greenwich
woolwich.snapshot: Woolwich is a busy corner of south-east London where full fibre is going in fast. We kit the build contractors and structured-cabling firms that run trade accounts and put whole crews on the street, and we serve the ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers who order direct online with no account. Branded polos, hi-vis and softshells for the fleet and the single installer alike, across the borough.
woolwich.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of south-east London
s1loc: Woolwich sits inside one of London's most active fibre corridors. Openreach is pushing full fibre out through the Royal Borough of Greenwich, while Digital Greenwich Connect, the council-backed joint venture, has built ultrafast network across Woolwich, Plumstead and out to Eltham town centre, passing thousands of social homes and businesses. London alt-nets including Community Fibre and Hyperoptic are live across the area, and Virgin Media keeps upgrading on top. Build contractors and their subbies work the streets, cabinets and customer premises from Woolwich Arsenal through Charlton and toward Lewisham every week.

Alongside the residential build sits a strong commercial scene. The Royal Arsenal Riverside development, the Woolwich Exchange and the trading estates off the A206 all need structured cabling, fibre and CCTV, as do the schools, the University of Greenwich campuses nearby and the multi-site retail and logistics units toward Charlton and Erith. Local cabling and security installers wire offices, blocks and yards in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre, and fit camera systems for industrial estates across the borough. It is steady work for firms that range from national contractors down to a single engineer with a van.
